name: Otoko no Ko Shiishii
source:
So, if you were the manager for an idol group what would be most important?
Obviously, the good health of your idols right!
Which means you have to do urine checks!
How much comes out,
How sweet it is,
The coloring and so forth.
Every idol has a personal pee concern you need to investigate!
Hoist the flag and dispel the mysteries of their urination!
Which girl merits the biggest concern?

An otoko no ko love piss exam ADVENTURE game!!
